text:
ci-bot: Pipeline alert for branch main: integration-tests failed after merge (PR #2782). Stage: chunking-integration. Failed shard: shard-12. Reason: timeout (300s).

jessica: ugh saw that, pinging owners @amar @kevin :eyes:

amar: looking now, taking first responder. re-running flaky stage for quick check.

amar: /ci rerun --stage integration-tests --shard shard-12

ci-bot: Re-run queued (job id 987654). ETA ~4m.

kevin: quick glance at the logs from the original run — repeated grpc chunking timeouts, stack:
```
ERROR src/chunker/service.rs:428 timed out waiting for chunk ack
trace: grpc::call=chunk_stream, peer=10.12.4.22:45000
last rpc: send_chunk timeout after 120s
```

maria: did this come in after the dep bump to tokio 1.32? saw a couple related heap/park warnings in other PRs.

devx: I can diff the runner config and the container image used by the failing shard. grabbing runner logs:
```
runner-12: image: inference/runner:2026-03-14
env: CI_WORKER=chunker-12
docker: Start OK
cpu: 2 cores, mem limit 6GB
```

amar: re-run completed, still failing on same shard with same timeout. job 987654 -> 987659

kevin: marking as non-flaky for now. Can someone start a quick bisect? suspect commit range between abc1234..def5678 (tokio bump + minor chunker tweak)

jessica: @sre-oncall can you check if shard-12 hosts are under CPU pressure or network egress throttling? :pray:

sre-oncall: I'll look. noticed kernel softirq spikes around 10:42 UTC on host chunker-12a. checking NIC stats.

sre-oncall: NIC RX drops ~2% over 5m window, also cpu steal at 5%. taking host out of rotation for immediate mitigation.

amar: thanks. If host was noisy that could explain it. I'll re-run targeted on shard-12b instead.

amar: /ci rerun --stage integration-tests --shard shard-12 --host chunker-12b

ci-bot: Re-run queued (job id 987660) on host chunker-12b.

kevin: still want to bisect the range to be safe. I can start a binary bisect unless someone else already on it.

maria: I'll take the bisect — starting with commit def5678 (current head) and abc1234 (last known good). will post results in thread.

maria: quick note: create a small repro harness to reproduce grpc chunking with artificial network delay. helps narrow down timing window.

jessica: appreciated. keep us posted. adding label "ci:investigating" on PR.

devx: I'll queue a hotpatch to move chunking tests to a different runner class temporarily while we triage.

amar: assign to me for triage and to coordinate revert if bisect points to our change.

kevin: thanks team. pinging back here with bisect outcome.

maria: bisect step 1/4: test failed at midpoint commit 0f1e2d -> indicates regression introduced between 0f1e2d..def5678. continuing.

jessica: ack. keeping PR on hold.

maria: bisect done — culprit commit: def2a1c (chunker: change rpc timeout behavior to 120s). rolling this up with @amar for revert plan.

amar: re-run after reverting def2a1c locally — integration-tests passed on shard-12 host chunker-12b. filing revert PR now.

jessica: thanks all. labeling incident resolved once revert merges and CI stabilizes.

ci-bot: Incident note: root cause identified (def2a1c) — revert PR #2790 opened by amar. CI green on verified shard runs.

maria: leaving notes in the changelog about timeout behavior and adding the small repro harness to prevent regressions.

jessica: nice work. :tada: Closing loop here. If anything else flares, re-open thread.
